steps.content: Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
You hear a few delicate metallic chimes ahead of you. The limbo chaos is suddenly split by an invisible force, revealing the blinding light of the outside world.
You see someone treading the sandstorm towards you. She hums a strange tune that dispels the frightful roar.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's... you... Stargazer?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Poor child... let me help you?
She speaks softly to you as countless black shadows spread out from the crystal ball in her hand. They wrap tightly around the pursuing Corruptors, stretching from their ankles to their necks.
The suffocating sensation makes the Corruptors tremble, and their eyes almost pop out of their sockets.
You hold your breath and your heartbeat quickens, as if you are also tightly entangled by these dark shadows.
...Is this her power?
You can feel it, she has not tried to hide it at all... It is the power of the Sinners, a power stemming from Mania.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're also a Sinner.
A playful smile spreads across Stargazer's face as she spins the crystal ball in her hand to call back the black shadows.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You don't seem to be afraid?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Let alone the Sinners... many people who witness my ability will faint on the spot.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm someone with the guts to go deep into WhiteSands. Surely I'm not that fragile.
You look around and decide to continue hiding your identity from Stargazer, although you're unsure if she already knows.
But as things stand now, even though the Corruptors have all been eliminated, the Apostles of Ashes still lingers nearby. You still need her help to escape.
You watch quietly as she approaches, not averting your gaze.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Do you fear me?
You shake your head.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No. You helped me twice. I have no reason to fear you. What I fear is... the Apostles of Ashes.
You watch the eerie black shadows loom closer and closer. You know very well that once they devour you, you will be reduced to a monster without a soul.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Fear is a prayer of pessimism, and the "Apostles" will answer that call. My dear guest, if you want this place to become Heaven, your heart must become Heaven first.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Sigh... it seems you still do not understand. Do I need to phrase it differently for you to comprehend?

Stargazer cups your face, turning your gaze away from the Apostles of Ashes and towards herself. 
You are mesmerized by her vivid purple eyes, and can no longer look away.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Poor dear, you look awful... seems like you are truly frightened.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Don't worry, with me by your side, you will be safe... lean on me as much as you wish.
No... Just as you blurt out your protest, the shell encasing the void and dead silence passes through you and Stargazer, before fading away into the whirling sands.
You look at Stargazer in mild disbelief.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: As I said, fear has power. It attracts and drives the Apostles of Ashes.
Stargazer gently caresses your face, as if teaching a child who knows nothing about the world.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The humans of DisCity think they understand WhiteSands. Yet whether it's WhiteSands or the world at large, there's too much that they're ignorant of.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ignorance breeds arrogance, and likewise fear. Over the years, the Apostles of Ashes have accumulated immeasurable power from fear.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: This is why DisCitizens keep perishing in WhiteSands despite wielding Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: They perish from the power of their own fear.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Thank you for saving me again just now.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You saved yourself. I just gave you a bit of guidance.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You have the power to resist against fear; you are just a bit lost. When the confusion dissipates, you shall become more resilient than others.
You start to say something, but Stargazer spins the crystal ball in her hand. The shapeless black mist inside diffuses, revealing your reflection.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: As for now... I think you need new strength and a new companion. That person shall be the one to show you the way forward.

You stare at Stargazer... You don't know whether her words count as "prophecy" or "guidance," but it is undeniable that she is a powerful Sinner. More importantly, she has knowledge and wisdom that even WhiteSands explorers can't match.
No matter what, you decide to try.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Try in the name of Quinn

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Have you heard of Quinn?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ah, Quinn... guests from Quinn have indeed sought my divination before. They pay quite generously.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: My trip to WhiteSands was initiated by Quinn's sponsorship. The intention was to further develop trade relations between WhiteSands and DisCity, but we were unexpectedly ambushed by desert bandits. If you continue to help me, I will apply for a substantial sum of funds to compensate your help.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Mm hmm... sounds tempting... however...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: New strength, a new companion... I think I see that right in front of me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Miss Stargazer, are you willing to join my... fleet, and continue to help me?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Afterwards, I will apply for a substantial sum of funds to compensate your help.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You know, the first half of what you said... is a lot like the vows exchanged by lovers at a wedding in DisCity.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Regardless of what you said in the second half, at least the first half makes me feel quite satisfied... however...
Stargazer squints her eyes, as if waiting for you to profess some more vows to sweeten the deal.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: How about this. You promise to do one thing for me, and I'll agree to this "deal."

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I'll tell you what you need to do later. Don't be nervous, it's nothing difficult.
Before you can answer, Stargazer boards the hovercraft and extends a hand towards you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Have you made up your mind? Will you come with me?
You seem to have no other choice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll come with you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I admire your decisiveness.
Before you can think things through, Stargazer yanks you onto the hovercraft.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It's time to get out of here.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Brace yourself for the real WhiteSands.
After some violent turbulence, the hovercraft begins using the air currents as its course to weave through the gaps of the sandstorm.
You never thought that one could navigate through a sandstorm without a Hypercube force field. Exposed to the sands, you instinctively worry about your well-being.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Don't be afraid. The desert approves of you.
Stargazer's nonchalant words echo in your ears. Before you have a chance to ponder the meaning of her words, you see her calmly maneuvering the hovercraft towards a huge wall of sand.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Be careful!
As soon as you say that, the strong pressure you had been encountering abruptly disappears.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: There. I have completed your request.
You sit in the back of the hovercraft, floating gently across the white desert. The sandy winds around you gradually weaken, and the harsh whistling sound fades from your ears.
We... escaped?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Escape? Hmm... I suppose for you, the word "escape" is indeed fitting.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Let me think. There should be a shelter around here...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ah yes... this way...
Stargazer raises her finger and casually points to the distance. You squint your eyes, spotting a small black dot resembling a building in the distance.
However, when you get closer, you encounter some unwanted guests—sandworms.

The Tide of Ashes has receded, but spurred by its aftereffects, the sandworms are still in a state of frenzy. They frantically thrash against the shelter's Hypercube force field, trying to attack all the lifeforms they can sense.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ahhhh... I had wanted to take you to the shelter to sort things out, but now...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: The shelter is in an even stickier situation than us!

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: You've suffered from the sandworms before, yet you still have the courage to face them again. You've got guts.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: There are innocent people in the shelter. I can't just sit back and do nothing.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And... with you around, these sandworms shouldn't be too much of a problem.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But right now there are only two of us. It's a bit hard to deal with frenzied sandworms while also trying to protect the shelter at the same time. The best solution in this situation is to lure them away from the shelter without any direct conflict.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Right now, their attention is entirely on the living beings inside the shelter. How do we...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I have a way to lure them away, but they need to calm down first. It looks like they'll be in a frenzied state for quite some time.
Cracks have already formed on the shelter's force field. If no action is taken, it will only be a matter of time before the sandworms break through.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We can't wait any longer. I'll find a way to calm them down... or at least distract them from the shelter.
You hop off the hovercraft and run towards the shelter.
Since the power of the Ash Crystals is related to the power of Mania, could the power of your shackles have some effect on the sandworms? You grit your teeth and decide to give it a try.
